criteria.obscure: A furniture type that few ordinary people recognize, even by name. This includes little-known historical, regional, or specialist pieces that usually require niche furniture knowledge.
criteria.not: Reject appliances, architectural fixtures, rooms, purely decorative objects, materials, brands without a furniture type, and invented objects. Also reject several separate furniture items or instructions.
